scope: ExtrudeCrv explicit Surface tangent and crease splitting, profile-first capped construction and native rational cap normalization, typed support frames, remembered split choices and atomic interactive direction editing.

comparisons.geometry: Complete used NURBS surfaces, spatial edges, UV trims, knots, weights, tolerances, face senses and oriented incidence
correspondence: B-rep vertex and edge numbering, preserving native face order
Two unused full-vector padding knots omitted by OpenNURBS/3DM
Equivalent orientation-preserving cap-axis exchanges, preserving the complete rectangular model-space support and mapping every rational trim control
Unused native surface-table slots excluded; every used face definition retained

headless.native_captures: Private Xvfb/i3 and private runtime directory via tools/rhino_oracle/run_headless.sh, Wayland/compositor sockets unset, only owned Rhino closed
headless.application_tests: test_app state without DISPLAY, WAYLAND_DISPLAY, WAYLAND_SOCKET, SWAYSOCK or I3SOCK; no GUI event loop

limits: G1/G2 angular admission is sampled, without a continuous maximum-angle certificate
Local cap coordinate axes may differ from Rhino
Split memory between successful commands and cancelled edits has native evidence; its independence from geometry Undo/Redo is locally regression-tested
Shared refinement and exact-partition resource limits apply
